name: Onta Pottery Village

en.name: Onta Pottery Village
en.description: A small, secluded pottery village in the mountains of Hita where traditional Onta ware (Onta-yaki) has been produced for over 300 years using water-powered clay crushers. Designated as an Intangible Cultural Property.
highlights: Hear the rhythmic sounds of water-powered clay crushers
Purchase handmade Onta ware directly from local kilns
Explore the preserved traditional mountain village atmosphere
en.openingHours: Open 24 hours (village access); Kiln shops generally open 09:00 - 17:00.

ja.name: 小鹿田焼の里
ja.description: 日田市の山あいに位置する小さな陶芸の里。300年以上にわたり、川の水力を利用した唐臼で土を砕き、伝統的な小鹿田焼（おんたやき）を作り続けています。国の重要無形文化財に指定。
highlights: 川の水力を利用した唐臼の音色
窯元で直接手作りの小鹿田焼を購入
昔ながらの山村の風景を散策
ja.openingHours: 24時間開放（集落）。窯元の店舗は概ね09:00〜17:00。
